name: Color Histogram Shift
description: Detects face vs background color histogram shift
algorithm: Color Histogram Shift — 像素级空间分析
mechanism:
This method detects temporal color histogram shifts for video deepfake detection following Zheng et al. (2021):

1. **Per-Frame颜色直方图计算**: For each frame, color histograms are computed in multiple color spaces (RGB, HSV, Lab) across face and background regions separately. Histograms capture the overall color distribution with bin resolution tuned to detect subtle shifts.

2. **Inter-Frame直方图比较**: Consecutive frame histograms are compared using Earth Mover's Distance (EMD), chi-squared distance, and Bhattacharyya distance. Natural video shows smooth, gradual histogram evolution. Deepfakes may produce frame-to-frame color distribution jumps, especially when the face generator's color model differs from the source video.

3. **人脸-Background颜色相干性**: The color histogram relationship between face regions and background is analyzed per frame. In authentic video, face and background share the same white balance and color grading. Deepfake face insertion may introduce subtle color distribution mismatches — the generated face may have different color temperature or saturation characteristics than the background.

4. **时间颜色稳定性分析**: Long-term color histogram trends are tracked. Natural illumination changes produce smooth, physically motivated color shifts (gradual, affecting all regions similarly). Deepfakes may produce oscillating or jerky color histogram changes as the generator struggles to maintain consistent color rendering across frames.

5. **直方图异常评分**: Statistical tests detect frames with significant color histogram deviations from temporal neighbors. The score combines inter-frame stability, face-background coherence, and long-term trend analysis, quantifying the likelihood of color manipulation or AI generation artifacts.
parameters:
分析类型: 像素
媒体: 视频
输入: Video frames extracted at key intervals
输出: 置信度分数 (0-100)
Frame sampling: Adaptive (1-5 fps depending on method)
Temporal window: Sliding window across frame sequence
accuracy: 中到高 — 70-88% 独立准确率. Most effective when combined with other 视频 forensic methods. Performance depends on 视频 quality, resolution, and compression level.
source: Video forensics and deepfake detection research. Based on computer vision and temporal signal analysis methods.
useCase: Detection of deepfake and AI-generated 视频 through color histogram shift analysis. This method examines temporal and spatial features that are difficult for AI systems to perfectly replicate, providing evidence for 视频 authenticity assessment.
strengths:
• Captures temporal artifacts that single-frame analysis misses
• Works with standard 视频 formats
• Effective against common deepfake techniques
• Can be combined with other 视频 forensic methods
• Based on established computer vision research
limitations:
• Performance affected by 视频 compression and resolution
• Some methods require sufficient frame count for temporal analysis
• Effectiveness varies with deepfake generation technique
• Best used as part of a comprehensive multi-method pipeline
• May produce false positives on heavily edited authentic 视频

references.title: Zheng, Y. et al. (2021). Exploring Temporal Coherence for More General Video Face Forgery Detection. ICCV.
Verdoliva, L. (2020). Media Forensics and DeepFakes: An Overview. IEEE JSTSP.
